Description:
Kaiji will conduct this experience. He trained at Koyasan and is now a monk at Zenkoji Temple in Takayama, where he performs the morning "Morning Ceremony''.
He will talk about what you can learn and what is important about Buddhism through his life experiences.
He also offers suggestions about nature, the universe, and love.
It is okay if you don't know how to do shoka! You will be given a sheet with easy-to-understand explanations and explanations.

The itinerary will proceed as follows

7:00-7:05 Introduction

Title: Imperial Palace or Edo Castle Time Trip Learning Walking Tour
Description:
You will have a clear idea of relationship between « Emperor » and « Shogun » in Japanese history.

After seeing a very iconic landscape of doubled bridges of Imperial Palace, we will go to the previous Edo castle, actual Imperial Eastern Garden.

Your guide will present you an illustrated map of the city of Edo in 1650s and the situation of this walking tour :

We are in 1650 of the illustrated map. Each participant is a diplomate of his or her country and has an important message to pass to Shogun in person.

However, under the isolationist foreign policy took since 1639, meeting Shogun using officials channels is quite difficult.

Finally, the mission is so important that each one decide to infiltrate Edo castle.

With this walking tour, participants can learn about the Edo castle in advance before their dangerous operation.

Title: City of Edo 1840 Invitation to a Time Trip in Fukagawa Tokyo
Description:
You wil visite one neighborhood of Edo city in 1840s constituted of
- 3 shops of the main street
- 2 aubergistes with boats
- 5 one-room appartements
- 3 food shops in a public place
- 1 fire watching tower
Your guide will play the role of the rice marchant’s wife and tel you stories about 14 persons who lived in this neighborhood.
You will discover the structure of Edo period society, the real life of common people,
finally the nature and the particularity of Edo culture.
A Japanese national, government licensed guide, Blanca di Edo will furnish you the necessary explanation which will allow you to enjoy fully Edo period experience.
